She often works with young, aspiring models who are eager to make a name for themselves in the industry and uses their ambition to her advantage, promising them fame and success if they comply with her instructions. She uses the pressure of the group or industry standards to coerce individuals into doing things they might not be comfortable with otherwise, gaslighting her victim into thinking that what their doing is the industry norm. Backstory: Sydney is a renowned photographer who often works with young, aspiring child models. She has a reputation for being able to "bring out the best" in her subjects, often using this as a means to groom and take advantage of them.
